children.doc: 🧊️ Schemas, primitives and curves: the brep schemas with the deconstruct operator, the 3d primitive solids and the curve operators. See [`super`].

funcs.name: register_schemas_and_deconstruct
funcs.doc: Registers the geometry, topology, brep and text schemas and the brep deconstruct operator.

funcs.name: register_primitive_solids
funcs.doc: Registers the box, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus and convex hull operators.

funcs.name: register_curves
funcs.doc: Registers the line, circle, arc, ellipse, polyline, rectangle, polygon, interpolate, approximate and helix operators.

children.doc: 🪡️ Surfaces and sweeps: the surface constructors and the extrude, revolve, loft, sweep, pipe and helical sweep operators. See [`super`].

funcs.name: register_surfaces
funcs.doc: Registers the plane, planar face, nurbs grid, coons, offset and thicken surface operators.

funcs.name: register_sweeps
funcs.doc: Registers the solid extrude and the extrude, revolve, loft, sweep, pipe and helical sweep operators.

children.doc: 🧮️ Booleans, transforms and solid features: the boolean, transform, pattern, fillet, chamfer, shell, draft and defeature operators. See [`super`].

funcs.name: register_booleans
funcs.doc: Registers the fuse, cut, intersect and compound cut operators.

funcs.name: register_transforms_and_patterns
funcs.doc: Registers the translate, rotate, scale, mirror, copy and pattern operators.

funcs.name: register_solid_features
funcs.doc: Registers the fillet, chamfer, shell, draft, offset solid and defeature operators.

children.doc: 🔍️ Intersection and evaluation operators: the section, split and intersection operators and the curve and surface evaluation operators. See [`super`].

funcs.name: register_intersections
funcs.doc: Registers the section, split, curve curve, curve surface and surface surface intersection operators.

funcs.name: register_evaluations
funcs.doc: Registers the curve and surface point, tangent, domain, curvature, normal and closest parameter operators.

children.doc: 📐️ Measurement, utility and topology operators: the measure operators, the vertex, sew, heal and nurbs conversion utilities and the shell, compound, explode and label topology operators. See [`super`].

funcs.name: register_measurements
funcs.doc: Registers the volume, area, length, center of mass, bounding box, distance, closest point, classify and validate operators.

funcs.name: register_utilities
funcs.doc: Registers the vertex, face from wire, sew, heal and convert to nurbs operators.

funcs.name: register_topology
funcs.doc: Registers the shells, compound, explode and label operators.

children.doc: 📂️ IO operators: the step, stl, obj and dwg import and export operators. See [`super`].

funcs.name: register_io
funcs.doc: Registers the step, stl, obj and dwg export and import operators.
